experiment.name: Live run of 23 October 2026: 4 models x 3 strategies on the 3 demo topics
experiment.description: First run with the real models, 5 questions per job. It used each provider's default sampling settings (the fixed settings came on 29 October). 30 of 36 jobs succeeded: Mistral Small 4 was still called through OpenRouter, whose shared pool answered HTTP 429. For the two key-balancing strategies the models' own key letters were not recorded yet. Cost: 0.31 USD at list prices.
